value.0: You already know Blood Frenzy in the only way I will teach it: under control. Keep it that way.
No. Your hands are not ready for Blood Frenzy. Come back when your cuts stop chasing the next kill.

The blade is already telling on you. Not the grip, the breath after a kill. If you want Blood Frenzy, start by recovering my Red Vein Codex from the scavengers studying it in the Viscara Sewers Depths.
Six scavengers down, one codex back in my hand. Do that without making a banquet of it.
The Red Vein Codex is still in the Viscara Sewers Depths. Six scavengers, one codex. No wasted motion.
That binding. Hm. They read the warnings and kept only the appetite.
Credits for the hazard. The lesson starts with timing, not rage.
Good. You did not rush the return. Now the rhythm. Pulse-Frame Training Droids are beating my old cadence into anyone foolish enough to listen. Break them and bring me the pulse metronome.
Count thirteen beats. On the thirteenth, the opening is yours. Bring the metronome core back intact.
The Pulse-Frame Droids are still keeping time in the Viscara Sewers Depths. Shut them down and bring me the metronome.
Hear that tiny skip? That is where a patient blade wins.
Keep the metron. In your head, not your pack. Your hand moves after the beat, never before it.
Someone took Blood Frenzy and poured stims into it. The Blood Frenzy Butcher is proof. Cut him down in the Viscara Sewers Depths lab and bring me adrenal glass from his table.
Do not match his speed. Let him spend it. When he empties, end him.
The Butcher is still in the Viscara Sewers Depths lab. I need the adrenal glass, and I need him gone.
Clotted, overcooked, ugly. This is what happens when discipline rots.
Hazard pay. And a warning: if your pulse starts asking for orders, stop listening.

I can make a restraint charm from this glass, but the duelists carry the matching fragments. They will not give them up politely. Take four from the Blood Frenzy Duelists in the Viscara Sewers Depths.
Four fragments. No trophies, no speeches. Bring them back before their school finds a new throat to shout through.
Four charm fragments from the Blood Frenzy Duelists. If they posture, let them. Posture has openings.
Good. These pieces remember restraint better than their owners did.
Now I can bind the lesson. The next cut is the one that matters.
Kess Draavo calls himself the Blood Frenzy King. He teaches the moment after a kill as hunger, not control. Find him in the Viscara Sewers Depths and end his circle.
No codex this time. No charm. Just the teacher who broke the lesson. Bring back silence.
Kess Draavo is still breathing in the Viscara Sewers Depths. The Blood Frenzy King does not get a second school.
I felt the rhythm stop from here.
Then Blood Frenzy is yours. It is not bloodlust. It is the half-second after victory when your body wants to waste itself, and you refuse.
Show me the first cut.
I recovered the Red Vein Codex.
The scavengers still have it.
The work is done.
I will break their rhythm.
I brought the pulse metron.
The droids are still ticking.
The work is done.
The Butcher falls.
I have the adrenal glass.
The lab is not finished.
The work is done.
I will take the fragments.
I recovered the charm fragments.
The fragments are still out there.
The work is done.
I will end his circle.
Kess is still alive.
The work is done.
Not now.
